runes.name: Rune of Echoes
runes.desc: The socketed skill repeats once at 40% damage 0.25 s later (attack skills only).

runes.name: Rune of Cinders
runes.desc: Hits from the socketed skill ignite: 3 damage/s for 3 s, plus a brief ground scorch.

runes.name: Rune of the Gale
runes.desc: The socketed dodge leaves a wind burst behind, dealing 10 knockback damage.
